reasoning_content:
Interesting point: even in the released 3.1.3 distribution, openstreetmap does not declare a dependency on geocoder. But the reason example.org's installation might still work is that the released version's sync config (inside the project's config/sync directory) might not contain openculturas_openstreetmap. Wait, example.org's config/sync is empty (count 0). Hmm, but the distribution's profile config is at $D/profile/config. When you run drush site:install openculturas without --existing-config, Drupal uses the profile's install list and the profile's config (config/install, config/optional) — it doesn't use the project's config/sync. So in the released project, site:install without --existing-config uses the profile's install list (166 modules, which in the released version may include openculturas_openstreetmap, or may not include it).

Let me check the released profile's install list to see whether it includes openstreetmap. Also, let me check whether the released version's openculturas.info.yml declares a geocoder dependency somewhere. Actually — in the released version, openculturas_openstreetmap might not be part of the profile's install list at all, and might be installed separately via drush en. Let me check.

action.command:
cd /workspace/example.org
D=web/profiles/contrib/openculturas-distribution
echo "=== released: openstreetmap in profile install list? ==="
awk '/^install:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' $D/profile/openculturas.info.yml | grep -n "openstreetmap\|geocoder" 
echo "=== released: geocoder in install list? ==="
awk '/^install:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' $D/profile/openculturas.info.yml | grep -c "geocoder"
echo "=== released: is openculturas_openstreetmap even present in release? ==="
ls $D/profile/modules/custom/ | head -20
